why: The story names young Fitzroy Simpson as the person arrested.

text: Wednesday: a whole day of waiting
why: The telegrams came Tuesday evening and it is now Thursday, so 'yesterday', when Holmes waited hour to hour for news, was Wednesday.
The horse has disappeared and Holmes expected it to be found, so where it is stands as an open question.

text: Where is Silver Blaze? — taken far away
why: The horse is missing and Holmes doubted it could stay hidden on the sparsely inhabited moor, which gives reason to consider that it was taken elsewhere.
